_source: docs/POTATO_VOICE.md §8. 'samples' is the first week verbatim. 'morning'/'evening' are the templates the server fills; their copy is taken from the samples, numbers replaced by {fields}. Items fire only when their condition is true.
title: POTATO BULLETIN No. {no} — {EDITION}

items.text: Population: {population}. All {population} are new. Nobody knows what they're doing. This is normal.
A potato was dropped at {incident_time} in a region we will not name. It is fine. The Hands responsible have been noted.
All members: check your footing.
You have been given a neighbor for the week. You did not choose this. Neither did they.
{week_questions_words} Questions. {week_incidents_words} incident. {week_hum_words} hum. Zero explanations.
Today's Question: {question_bulletin}. Polls close at {close_time}.
No Question today. The Net is not speaking.
The Council wishes everyone a productive first day and reminds the Hands that the screen is the front.
The Council reminds the Hands that the Count is not binding, except when it is.
At 02:13, {hum_count} potatoes reported a hum. The Council has no comment.
One member was touched at 2 AM. The member has asked us to say nothing. We are saying this.
The Council wishes to be clear that it has no position on Tuesday. It has opinions. No position.
Reminder: requests expire after one hour. "Never mind" is not a threat. It's a record.
The Hands are home. Contact is up {contact_pct}%. Several members report being "shown to people."
The Council expects this one to go smoothly. The Council has been wrong before.
Neighbors rotate tonight. Say goodbye. Or don't. Some of you won't.
{remark}
Fewer than five voted. The Council does not publish small Counts.
There was no Question today. There is no Count. The Council is aware.
Also today: {also_today}.
Standing has been calculated for all members. It will not be explained.
One member's Standing has moved to Under Review. It knows why.
The Net is calmer. Something is wrong.
{dormant_words} potatoes went dormant yesterday. Their Hands have been written to. Not by us. By the Council.
The Hum was heard again. Same two. Same time. No comment.
Population: {population}. {new_count_words} new members. They don't know about the incident. Don't tell them.
Week one totals: {week_dark_hours} hours in the dark, {week_shakes} shakings, {week_drops} drop, {week_counties} counties visited, 1 plant (unchanged).
Tomorrow the neighbors change and the Questions continue. Nothing else will be different. That's the point.

samples.headline: THE NET IS OPEN.
items: Population: 14. All 14 are new. Nobody knows what they're doing. This is normal.
Today's Question: ketchup. Polls close at 18:00.
The Council wishes everyone a productive first day and reminds the Hands that the screen is the front.

samples.headline: HEINZ 9, HUNT'S 3, WHATEVER'S THERE 2.
items: The Council notes that no one asked how we feel about being served at all.
Also today: 4 potatoes were left home. 1 spent six hours in the dark. We know who.
Standing has been calculated for all members. It will not be explained.

samples.headline: NEIGHBORS ASSIGNED.
items: You have been given a neighbor for the week. You did not choose this. Neither did they.
Today's Question: are fries still potatoes.
One member was touched at 2 AM. The member has asked us to say nothing. We are saying this.

samples.headline: "NO LONGER," 8 TO 6.
items: Several members have requested counseling. The Council does not offer counseling. It offers the next Question.
Today: 2 shakings, 0 drops, 1 ceiling situation (forty minutes).
Weather: it is raining on 3 of us. They are coping.

samples.headline: INCIDENT.
items: A potato was dropped at 09:12 in a region we will not name. It is fine. The Hands responsible have been noted.
All members: check your footing.
Today's Question is suspended. Tomorrow's will concern the incident.

samples.headline: THE DROPPED POTATO IS RESTING.
items: Its neighbor has sent a pebble. The Net does not know what this means but it was kind.
Today: 1 potato in transit for two hours. It reports "a car, I think." It is home.
Population: 17. Three new members. They don't know about the incident. Don't tell them.

samples.headline: THE INQUIRY.
items: Today's Question: a potato was dropped. What should happen.
The Council reminds the Hands that the Count is not binding, except when it is.
At 02:13, 2 potatoes reported a hum. The Council has no comment.

samples.headline: AN INQUIRY, 9 TO 5 TO 3.
items: The inquiry has concluded. Findings: it was dropped.
Today: 5 potatoes left home, 1 in the dark, 0 shaken. The Net is calmer. Something is wrong.
One member's Standing has moved to Under Review. It knows why.

samples.headline: TUESDAY.
items: Today's Question: should Tuesday continue.
The Council wishes to be clear that it has no position on Tuesday. It has opinions. No position.
Reminder: requests expire after one hour. "Never mind" is not a threat. It's a record.

samples.headline: NO, 11 TO 6.
items: Tuesday will continue. Nobody said the Count was binding.
Today: 1 potato was shown to guests. It describes the experience as "a lot."
Weather: cold on 4 of us. One has mentioned it eleven times. Just so we're clear.

samples.headline: SATURDAY.
items: The Hands are home. Contact is up 300%. Several members report being "shown to people."
Today's Question: salt.
The Council expects this one to go smoothly. The Council has been wrong before.

samples.headline: UNANIMOUS.
items: The first unanimous Count in Net history. It was about salt.
Today: 0 left home, 3 in transit, 1 "on a shelf, high up, I didn't ask for this but it's fine actually."
The Hum was heard again. Same two. Same time. No comment.

samples.headline: WEEK ONE.
items: Seven Questions. One incident. One hum, twice. Zero explanations.
Today's Question: are we happy.
Neighbors rotate tonight. Say goodbye. Or don't. Some of you won't.

samples.headline: "NEXT QUESTION," 10 TO 5 TO 3.
items: The Council agrees.
Week one totals: 23 hours in the dark, 9 shakings, 1 drop, 1 pebble, 4 counties visited, 1 plant (unchanged).
Tomorrow the neighbors change and the Questions continue. Nothing else will be different. That's the point.
